name: timetable-conflicts
title: University timetable conflict detection
prompt:
`find_conflicts(sessions)` in `timetable.py` must report every pair of sessions that conflict.

Each session is a dict: `id`, `day`, `start`, `end`, `room`, `teacher` (times like `"8:00"` or `"09:40"`).
Two sessions conflict when they are on the same day, their time ranges overlap, AND they share the
same room or the same teacher. Back-to-back sessions (one ends exactly when the other starts) do NOT
conflict.

Return a list of `(id_a, id_b)` tuples with `id_a < id_b`, sorted, without duplicates.
The current implementation gives wrong answers.
